plumbing.review:
Three findings prevent approval:

1. **[P1] CR line endings bypass encoding validation.** [python_deps.go:192](python_deps.go:192) normalizes CR before checking encoding declarations. Pip checks raw LF-delimited lines first. This input passes the Go validation but exposes a forbidden option after decoding:

   ```python
   b"# a\r# b\r# coding: unicode_escape\n# \\u000a--no-binary :all:\npackaging\n"
   ```

   This can enable source builds; substituting `--index-url` redirects installation. Validate encoding declarations before newline normalization and add regressions. The decoding behavior was confirmed with available pip 21.2.4; the pinned image still needs verification.

2. **[P2] Staging breaks valid local references containing `..`.** [python_deps.go:350](python_deps.go:350) creates only canonical file paths. With an existing empty `deps/`, `-r deps/../constraints.txt` passes validation, but staging omits `deps/`. Pip opens the unchanged path and fails because that directory is missing. Preserve the traversed directories and test this case.

3. **[P1] Required real-suite evidence is missing.** [tests.txt:59](tests.txt:59) shows only generated-recipe contract checks, without their real-execution branches. Run and retain passing output from the `INVARIANT_PYTHON_DEPS_REAL=1` command required at [README.md:126](README.md:126) on the final PR head.

The acceptance sources match the ratified plan and contain substantive assertions. Image-ID propagation, trusted commands, Nagini separation, scope and style otherwise look consistent. The merger’s dependency-policy decision and SPEC citations remain required, as documented at [README.md:132](README.md:132).

VERDICT: changes needed — fix encoding validation and reference staging, add regressions, provide passing real-suite evidence on the PR head, and complete the merger’s decision record and citations.

Before merge, the real Docker/PyPI suite must pass on the PR head. The merger must also record the dependency-policy decision and cite it in the changed SPEC bullets.
